nodes.label: Bring-Your-Own Google Cloud OAuth Client Requirement
nodes.rationale: This skill talks to official Google REST APIs and has no shared sign-in client; a stored token stays tied to the client that minted it, so a token from the old shared Thunderbird client keeps refreshing Gmail but Calendar 403s accessNotConfigured because that client's Cloud project has the Calendar API permanently disabled. Everyday Gmail belongs to email-client instead.

nodes.label: Google First-Use Data Gathering
nodes.rationale: Deep dive into sent mail, inbox, and calendar on first activation, mining personal texture for teasable quirks; hundreds of emails, not a token sample, then update MEMORY.md and the skill file's preference sections.
